title: Officials and staff still without a yearly financial statement, 2023 to 2026
question: How many officers and employees were still missing the yearly statement of economic interests months after the deadline, how many came back year after year, and how many were penalized?
finding: The 2023 list named 365 people on 6 June 2023; on 26 December 2023, nine months after the deadline, it still named 327, all of them already on the June list, among them 10 board or commission members. The lists for 2024, 2025 and 2026 name 96, 229 and 171. 89 people (same name and department) appear on two or more lists and 16 on three or more. The Commission’s penalty file holds 9 penalties for not filing since 2023, $11,150 in all. Members of the SoMa Community Stabilization Fund advisory committee appear on the 2023, 2025 and 2026 lists (5 people, 2 of them on two lists).
how: Each saved list is read row by row. A person is a first name, a last name and a department; the same person on two lists must match on all three. The 2023 and 2024 lists are web-archive copies (the Commission’s own addresses now answer ‘not found’); the 2024 copy says it was frozen on 3 June 2024. Penalties are the rows of the Commission’s penalty file with case category ‘SEI NonFiler’ dated 2023 or later; ‘on a list and later penalized’ is a first-and-last-name match only.
limits: A name stays on a list until the person files; the 26 December 2023 copy may not have been refreshed every day, and a person who had left the job may still be shown. Most people on the spring lists file within weeks. The penalty match is by name only, so it is a count of name matches, not of the same people. Whether the Commission or departments referred the others, and whether listed board members voted while listed, is not in these files. No person is named here.
